subject: EL-1: guidance origin binding + staleness sweep + plain-escalation dedup (A+B+C)
description:
Fix Mode-2 (no liveness) of the escalate pipeline. THREE coupled changes on feature branch orch/feature/escalate-liveness:

(A) ORIGIN BINDING. lib/overlay.js addGuidance(): accept and stamp origin_task (string|null) and origin_notes (string[]). At the request_guidance seam (routes/session.js ~L133 and L142, BOTH the gated and ungated addGuidance calls) pass origin_task from the claiming task context and origin_notes from the recalled note keys the gate already has (runAskGate result / context). The seam has the task ctx — thread it through.

(B) STALENESS SWEEP. Add sweepStaleGuidance() in daemon.js mirroring sweepStaleVerdicts() structure, and call it in the per-tick sweep block (next to sweepStaleVerdicts at ~daemon.js:1088). For each pending unresolved BLOCKING guidance with an origin_task: if that task's overlay.status is done OR its git.merged is set, auto-resolve it via overlayStore.resolveGuidance(ov, id, 'auto-stale: origin task completed') . For each with origin_notes: if ANY listed note key is superseded (note chain validTo set / supersededBy present — use the overlay note_nodes / noteChain helper), auto-resolve with 'auto-stale: triggering note superseded'. NEVER auto-resolve a guidance that has no origin_task AND no origin_notes (can't prove staleness) — leave those for humans. Demote nothing; just resolve. Idempotent.

(C) PLAIN-ESCALATION DEDUP. lib/overlay.js addGuidance(): for plain text guidance (no action object), dedup against an existing pending item with the same origin_task AND a normalized-question match (lowercase, collapse whitespace, strip punctuation, compare first ~120 chars or a simple hash). If found, return the existing id instead of pushing a new row — same pattern as the existing dup-cluster/follow-up dedup branches at overlay.js:654.

TESTS: this repo uses node test files. Add/extend unit tests for addGuidance dedup (C) and the sweep predicate (B) — a guidance whose origin_task is done resolves; one with a superseded origin_note resolves; one with neither stays pending. Keep changes surgical; match surrounding style. Do NOT touch the ask-gate predict corpus (that is EL-2/task D).
